description: This file defines the EntityConditionSubSelect class, which represents a sub-query condition used within entity queries in the OFBiz framework. It provides methods to generate SQL snippets for sub-select operations based on entity models and conditions.

classes.name: EntityConditionSubSelect
classes.description: Represents a sub-select condition used in entity queries, allowing inclusion of subqueries with WHERE conditions and join clauses within main SQL queries.

methods.name: addSqlValue
methods.description: Generates the SQL snippet for the sub-select condition, including SELECT, FROM, and WHERE clauses based on the entity model and conditions.
